extracted.intended_audience: Referees/reviewers for AEJ: Economic Policy (academic economists)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for academics serving as anonymous referees for manuscripts submitted to AEJ: Economic Policy, covering confidentiality, bases for recommendation, procedural submission, and suggested external reading for writing reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single‑blind review / referee anonymity
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts submitted to the AEJ: Economic Policy are reviewed in a single‑blind fashion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the referee(s) should remain anonymous to authors, we ask you not to use your name in the body or filename of your report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis of recommendation: robustness, credibility, publishability
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations should be based on whether the conclusions in the paper are robust, credible, and worthy of publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the paper on the substantive merits of its conclusions (robustness and credibility) and their suitability for publication rather than extraneous factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author disclosure statements and conflict‑of‑interest handling
rubrics_metrics.description: All manuscript submissions are accompanied by individual disclosure statements from each coauthor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While disclosure statements are collected, recommendations should not be based on whether potential conflicts of interest exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use ScholarOne Manuscripts for review submission
rubrics_metrics.description: The AEA uses ScholarOne Manuscripts for submission and peer review tracking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To see more information and instructions for submitting a review, log in and navigate to your Reviewer Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended external referee guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers are encouraged to read a brief set of guidelines on referee reports prepared by Econometrica and the more detailed guidelines published in the Journal of Economic Perspectives by Jonathan Berk, Campbell Harvey, and David Hirshleifer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These external guidelines do not represent official AEA policy, but you may find them helpful when preparing reports.
